themes.title: Right-Wing Political Alignment & Electoral Strategy
themes.blurb: Far-right and conservative parties across North America and Europe are negotiating complex post-election coalitions, local governance pacts, and midterm campaign positioning. From municipal alliance discussions in Sweden and Norway to presidential maneuvering in France and electoral rule battles in the US, right-wing movements are balancing ideological purity with practical governance.

France's Rassemblement National is aggressively rejecting Russian pressure and endorsing aid to Ukraine, while US leadership balances licensing missile production for Kyiv with tough stances against Iran.

themes.title: Nativist Labor Policies and Immigration Restrictions
themes.blurb: Populist conservative platforms are seeking to protect domestic labor markets through tighter visa restrictions, reduced funding for foreign assistance programs, and nativist political rhetoric. US leadership targets high-skilled foreign labor fees, complementing a broader European environment where anti-immigration narratives define right-wing appeal.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
